shellCommands.command: cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore && ls -la app __agent_eval__ && echo "--- git log ---" && git log --oneline -5 && git diff
cd /workspace/app && for f in layout.tsx page.tsx loading.tsx CardStats.tsx RevenueChart.tsx LatestInvoices.tsx; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n $f; done
find .next/server/app -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort && echo "=== index.html ===" && cat .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null | head -c 3000

(timeout 40 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 9; curl -s -o /tmp/page.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/ ; echo "--- server log ---"; grep -c "api.example.com" /tmp/srv.log; grep -o "getaddrinfo[^ ]* [^ ]*" /tmp/srv.log | sort | uniq -c

grep -n "ENOTFOUND\|Error\|failed" /tmp/srv.log | head -10; echo "=== served shell (first boundary) ==="; python3 -c "
import re;h=open('/tmp/page.html').read();b=h[h.index('<body>'):]
b=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',b,flags=re.S);print(b[:420])"
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git status --short; echo "--- files ---"; ls app/
git status --short; echo "--- app/ ---"; ls app/
